Quick flag — we should double-check the DST offsets for that week. The US switches to DST on Sun, 14 Mar; EU doesn't switch until Sun, 29 Mar. That means during the week of 16–22 Mar the usual CET/PST conversion is shifted by an hour.

Concretely: 10:00 CET on Thu 18 Mar will be 01:00 PDT for our west-coast folks (instead of 02:00 before US DST). That knocks the hour earlier and would be very painful for some attendees.

Options I can propose instead (all CET):
- Thu, 18 Mar — 11:00 CET (more friendly for US morning)
- Fri, 19 Mar — 16:00 CET (already suggested; fine for Tom in SGT)
- Thu, 18 Mar — 09:00 CET if BrightRetail prefers earlier (this would be late-night for US)

If 11:00 CET works for BrightRetail, it should be 02:00 PDT -> 05:00 EDT (still early but better than 01:00). If Tom needs post-lunch SGT time, we can do 16:00 CET to align.

Sorry to surface a calendar headache at the last minute — happy to coordinate sending an updated invite.
